referralCommissionSchedule: From interest, when repaid: generation 1 receives 15%; 2 receives 8%; 3 receives 6%; 4 receives 4%; 5 receives 2%; 6 to 12 receive 0.8%; 13 to 40 receive 0.4%. The fund keeps at least 40%. The first Level 1 paid does not share that generation’s 15%. If it is not repaid in 7 days, that amount goes to the fund.

payChoiceNow: Pay one installment, several, or the full balance. The final due date is what counts.

settingsGuideLead: Each section describes the tool and how to use it.
guideCreditBody: One credit at a time. Request the amount for your level and repay on the due date. Each on-time payment counts toward the next level. After the due date there is a regularisation period; then earnings pause until you are current.
guideNetworkBody: Your code and link identify whoever you invite. The person who invited you cannot be changed. Commissions settle when someone on your line repays, not when they request. There are up to 40 generations. The first Level 1 of a direct invitee does not pay that generation’s 15%. If it is not repaid in 7 days, that amount goes to the fund.
guideRachaBody: A direct invitee adds the day when a loan is fully repaid. Signing up does not count. Milestones of 7, 30, 100 or 365 days can be claimed. If the streak slips, ranking days fall. Streak fame does not decrease.
guideCanjeBody: Fame is collected on the path where it was earned. Donating or adding funds is exchanged here. Streak fame is collected only in Streak. 250 fame equals 1 USDT from the pool. Signup does not grant network fame.
guideBonusesBody: Every 100 levels there may be a fund bonus if available liquidity sits above the reserve floor. Level 100 pays 400 USDT; then 4,000, 7,000, 8,500, 9,000, 11,500, 13,500, 16,000, 18,000 and 20,000 at 1000. At 1000, every 100 on-time payments may be claimed again.
guideReservaBody: From level 10 you may lock USDT for 30 days, one position at a time. Principal returns to your account. If the provision has resources, an estimated yield of up to 12% a year may apply for that period. It is not guaranteed. This is not a bank deposit.
guideRanksBody: From level 15 you can see names, photos and positions. Divisions fill 100 at a time. Your place moves with referrals, repayments, fame, streak, level and bonuses.
guidePoolBody: This is the fund that finances loans. Contributions cannot be withdrawn. It finances credit, exchanges, bonuses and the Reserve extra.
canjeViaRacha: Streak fame: {points}. Claim it in Streak.
guideWalletBody: This is your account balance. With a linked wallet you deposit, pay onboarding and move funds. Requesting and repaying credit uses this same account.
guideIdentityBody: The 4 USDT onboarding enables credit. Email and phone are confirmed at no extra charge. On a Real account, declare your identity. Demo does not require email, phone or identity verification.
guideDonateBody: A voluntary contribution to the project, separate from onboarding and from the lending fund. Each 1 USDT adds 100 fame from the first unit.
guideHistoryBody: A record of credit, payments, transfers, onboarding, bonuses and donations on this account.
referralEarnExamples: If a direct referral repays these levels, you earn:
referralEarnAllLevelsLead: Generation-1 commission when each loan level is repaid, from 1 to 1000.
guideWalletEarn: It does not generate income by itself. It is the balance you operate with and where commissions, exchanges and bonuses arrive.
guideIdentityEarn: Email and phone have no charge. The 4 USDT onboarding enables credit. Demo still pays onboarding; identity is not required.
guideCreditEarn: You do not earn by requesting. You progress by paying on time: you level up, access larger amounts and may claim milestone bonuses.
guideNetworkEarn: Interest is shared by distance (15% on generation 1; then 8%, 6%, 4%, 2%, 0.8% and 0.4%). Signup does not grant network fame.
guideRachaEarn: 100 fame per valid day. Milestones pay 5, 25, 100 or 500 USDT from the fund. That fame is not exchanged in Exchange.
guideCanjeEarn: Converts box or network fame into USDT from the fund. Streak fame is not exchanged here.
guideBonusesEarn: Level 100: 400 USDT. Then 4,000, 7,000, 8,500, 9,000, 11,500, 13,500, 16,000, 18,000 and 20,000 at 1000. Claim it in Bonuses when it is available.
guideReservaEarn: The extra on your network commissions (10% from 50 USDT locked, 20% from 500) is paid from the lending fund. The estimated 12%, if any, comes from the Reserve provision.
guideDonateEarn: Adds fame for donating or contributing: 100 fame per 1 USDT. Redeem it in Exchange, on the matching tab.
guideRanksEarn: If there is a monthly allocation, it is estimated at 1.5% of available liquidity. Accounts in arrears do not receive it. Any unallocated amount remains in the fund.
guideHistoryEarn: It does not generate income. It lets you review activity on your account.
guidePoolEarn: Contributing adds box fame (100 per USDT), redeemed in Exchange. The capital is not withdrawn.
